core_meaning.primary_meaning: Razin is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Dignified, serious”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Razin corresponds to the Arabic form رَازِن (Arabic root ر ز ن (r-z-n); رَازِن (Rāzin)). Its core sense is razin; dignified, serious. Razin is Arabic رَازِن (Rāzin) 'dignified, serious', from the root ر ز ن (r-z-n). The source gloss 'Delight, Pleasure' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as razeen.

persian.name: رازن
